dm.summary: I started with 'look' and did not reload. The Circle page was up to date: all four reports were filed, Cass's amend was in the ticker and Bram had accepted Cass's Champion relationship, so all 11 relationships read Agreed. I read the back of each report card. Every player ticked only keys their investigator really fulfilled, and the lines and emoji displayed correctly. The page's total was +6: 2 for the two questions answered yes, plus 4 because all four investigators fulfilled a key. That matches FAQ p.55. I pressed Add 6 Illumination. The ring went from 0 to 6 of 12, the log said 'The Whistlers gains 6 Illumination (0 to 6).' and the question boxes locked. There was no milestone line, which is correct because the circle has no Resource Management. The track did not fill, so there was no advance. Before ending I looked at Cass's sheet, then pressed End Assignment. The confirm's 'i' explains what ends and says 'Drives carry over; a Refresh restores them.' After End, I checked the desk and the sheets: the dispatch was blank, the tray empty, the timer gone, the hourglass at 0 with no name, and gear was cleared, including on Cass's open sheet, live. Spend counts were back to 0 of 2, ability uses were reset, Dev's Train die was kept, the reports were cleared and closed, Illumination stayed at 6, and the circle resources were not refilled (correct by p.41). One question: spending stayed open after End Assignment. I logged 2 praise and 2 low ux findings and told the table (#55) what they will now see on their desks. No console errors, and no restart was needed.

Tension is 0 of 4 with no clock name; the timer is cleared and hidden; there is no dispatch. Reports are closed and empty, and the Circle page tally is +0. dm.story_so_far: The Whistlers crossed the Gullhaven estuary flats in fog, found the psalm stamped on the chain links and learned that the ferry bell was a recording. In the ferryman's cottage they opened the tide-ledger of fares and found that Absalom Hode had been made part of the ferry. On the ferry mid-channel, Bram jammed the windlass, Dev's salt ward stopped the counting voice, and Cass, battered to Body 3 of 3 by the water, cut the empty coat from the bell. Ada read out the first fare, Hode's own, so he was carried over and the psalm was laid to rest. The circle filed honest reports and gained 6 Illumination (6 of 12). The assignment is ended. The soaked ledger still ends with Ada's name in the slanting hand, a hook for later.
dm.for_players: 1. Without reloading, check that your desk shows the assignment ended: the log line, a blank dispatch, an empty hourglass with no name, an empty dice tray, empty gear slots, your ability shown as available again, and 'Circle spends this assignment 0 / 2'. Anything stale is a finding. 2. On the Circle page, check that Illumination reads 6 of 12, your report is cleared and reports are closed. 3. Optionally spend between assignments, since spending is still open: Cass could use a Stitch to clear Body 3 and Bleed 1, and anyone low on drives could use a Refresh. Check that the counts and log update. 4. Look at whether the site offers a way to choose gear again for the next assignment.
